aws_autoscaling_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on aws_launch_template.ng, but it already references aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and .latest_version in its mixed_instances_policy block, so the dependency is established implicitly and the explicit entry is redundant.

aws_eks_node_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.ng, but it already references aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn via its node_role_arn attribute, so the dependency is established implicitly and the explicit entry is redundant.

aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate has an explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.fargate, but it already references aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn via its pod_execution_role_arn attribute, so the dependency is established implicitly and the explicit entry is redundant.

aws_autoscaling_group.ng has an explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.ng, but this ordering is already guaranteed transitively: aws_autoscaling_group.ng depends on aws_launch_template.ng (via launch_template_id), which depends on aws_iam_instance_profile.ng (via iam_instance_profile.arn), which depends on aws_iam_role.ng. The explicit entry is redundant.
